config.attention_definition: float64 softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(head_dim)), causal prefixes, no extra bias
config.attention_scope: NumPy reconstruction from captured post-RoPE vectors; not native BF16 score replay
config.depth_one_match_definition: all causal keys including current and mandatory recent; optional_older excludes recent min(8,budget,prefix)
config.flat_dot_offset_policy: center @ projection derived per selection call, not cached; zero additional stored state
config.flat_score_parameter_sharing: exact same centroids, key codes, center and projection; no extra fitting
config.historical_slice_note: position 31 is still full attention and is excluded from affected_queries
config.output_endpoint: unprojected per-query-head weighted V; aggregate sqrt(sum squared error / sum squared reference norm)
config.primary_flat_score: negative squared Euclidean distance in the shared centered 2D embedding
config.product_metric: max_coordinate_finite_padic_distance; zero for equal finite coordinate
config.secondary_flat_score: uncentered projected dot product, restoring center @ projection to query and assigned centroid
config.zero_reference_nrmse: zero if both reference and error energy are zero; null if only reference energy is zero

interpretation: Finite balls exactly equal matched tries. Shared PCA separation is a tested hypothesis, not an assumed diagnosis.

memory_scope.state_bytes_definition: actual NumPy numeric buffers, padding and fit metadata included; Python/file-container overhead excluded
memory_scope.trace_storage_note: repeated per-query-head float32 capture is not the physical model KV-cache footprint

scope: Fixed reused-validation component diagnostic; no model forward/training, token NLL, confirmation or native speed claim.
timing_scope: functional NumPy gate including calibration, controls and intermediate artifact writes; no efficiency claim
